name: A Style-Fusion Symposium
description: After playing Rhythm Ball for a while, some of your companions want to share their thoughts with you...

dialogs.content: Mizuki! Mizuki! Amina just told me some amazing news!
Thanks to the party, the People of the Springs had forty percent more visitors than normal! And to think, we barely did anything to promote it!
That's great! I also have some good news... Over the past few days, the number of patients at my practice has dropped by ninety percent!
If our goal was to lift people's spirits and give them a space to let go of their worries, I think we can safely say... That's a job well done!
Haha, then let's go even bigger next time! Add even more games!
That way, there's something for everyone — hot springs if you want relaxation, games if you want fun... As far as vacations go, you can't get much better than that!
Hey! Mualani! Mizuki!
The musical genius has returned!
Hehe, say no more! It's written all over your face! You had a blast, didn't you?
Are you kidding!? An all-you-can-eat, self-serve buffet? Paimon was on cloud nine! She had five servings of Hot Spring O'Clock!
#And {NICKNAME} was even more obsessed with the Rhythm Ball than Paimon with the free food!
Ehe.
Honestly, watching you play was quite the spectacle! An expert performance if I ever saw one!
You should help me brainstorm the next time we host something like this! We can come up with even more fun games!
#As far as I know, that does seem to be one of {NICKNAME}'s many talents.
I look forward to working with you again, Miss Mualani. Although, it would be easier if you had a designated office space... Why don't I help you open a consultancy?
Ooh, I like the sound of that! Let me ask around! If there's space... We could put it right next to your clinic!
Good idea! I'd love nothing more than to be neighbors.
Man, I want to live here, too!
Ooh, all-you-can-eat buffets and hot springs every day... Oh yeah, that sounds like the life, hehe...
Well, if you had a permanent address, it would be easier to track you down if we need something.
Never knew the day would come when I'd sound like one of my clients.
Oh, Xilonen!
The music you picked for Rhythm Ball was excellent! Every time we played the game, we would start dancing before we knew it!
Glad to hear it.
From what I've observed over the past few days, you have great potential as "fusion" artists.
It could be because you've encountered music from all sorts of different cultures. When you're immersed in the melody, it's almost like you can incorporate different beats on instinct.
The most cutting-edge music often involves some form of "fusion." So, I have a feeling I'll be coming to you for inspiration one day.
Here, I want you to have this. Give it a listen sometime.
What is it?
No way! One of Xilonen's mixtapes! At Xochicuicatl Records, that would sell in a heartbeat!
Ah, yes. Not everyone can get their hands on the records or equipment Miss Xilonen recommends. It's a source of anxiety for some people. I once treated a patient for that very reason...
...You can treat even that, Miss Mizuki?
All I did was help her manage her emotions. I told her to consider getting a job at the record store. Then, she would be one of the first to get information on your latest recommendations.
Hah, good idea... I just hope she can keep it to herself, or job applications are about to become just as hard to snag...
Well, thanks for this.
Yeah! Paimon can't wait to hear it!
Next time, we'll help you come up with an even better game... With music that's just as amazing as this time, of course!
That's a promise! People won't know what hit 'em!
Man, the party isn't even over, and Paimon already can't wait for the next one! The People of the Springs really know how to live it up...
I'll give it a good listen.
More time in the People of the Springs... Count us in!
No, no, no. Nothing can compare to your obsession with food!
Two happy visitors here to give you a five-star review!
